verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://appwrite.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200, and docs.md links to a nested documentation index. First-party docs say any docs page can be fetched as raw Markdown by appending .md, and they also offer open-source agent Skills files and an MCP server that gives LLMs access to the docs. Missing for 10: independent or community reports of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.
